plan.summary: FEAT-PROJELER slice S4: the operator-facing Projeler page. Adds 5 Backend proxy routes /api/v1/outbound/projects/* (data_lists GR4 precedent) over the S2 Outbound CRUD, a typed api.ts client + types, a new ProjectsPage.tsx (list + single X-close create/edit modal: name + description + multi-select target data-lists with live sendable counts + archive), the /projects App.tsx route, and the Layout.tsx + Backend /api/v1/inma/nav 'Projeler' nav entry (dual-source synced). METADATA-ONLY (Q decision): the WhatsApp template picker + instance + send land in PR-4 (S2 CRUD has no cxapi-config columns yet). No send path; the S3 wa-templates endpoint is NOT consumed in S4.
plan.q_intent: Continue PKT-14 after S3 (cxapi template-list). Proceed with S4 — Projeler React page + wizard (DataImportPage pattern, X-only modal) + Backend proxy routes for /api/v1/projects (data_lists GR4 precedent) + api.ts + App.tsx route + Layout nav. Send action stays hidden until PR-4 + gate lift. Do S3+S4 back-to-back.
plan.interview_notes: Decisions (AskUserQuestion 2026-06-07): (1) Template picker DEFERRED to PR-4 — S4 is metadata-only (name + description + target data-lists); S2 CRUD has no cxapi-config columns (inert until PR-4), so a template selection has nowhere to persist; the S3 /api/v1/settings/wa-templates endpoint stays ready but is NOT consumed in S4 (no unused api.ts method either — added in PR-4 with its picker). (2) Single X-close modal create/edit form (NOT a 3-step wizard) — name + description + a multi-select of the tenant's data-lists showing live sendable_count; matches Q's modal-X-close UX rule. Defaults (not separately asked): nav item lives in 'Çalışma Alanı' after 'Veri Yönetimi', always-visible (no feature flag, mirrors Veri Yönetimi) with the calm 403 'not enabled' state when ProjectsOptions denies (INV-OB-066); DELETE surfaces as 'Arşivle' (S2 is soft-delete-as-archive). The nav is dual-source (Layout.tsx ALL_NAV_ITEMS + Backend /api/v1/inma/nav) and BOTH are updated in lockstep (2026-06-04 lesson).

acceptance_criteria.verification_note: Codex (gpt-5.5) iter0 PASS — CQ9 + CoVe Q1.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A new tenant-facing ProjectsPage at the /projects route (under ProtectedRoute + Layout) lists the tenant's projects (name, status, target_count, sent/delivered/failed counters, created_at) and offers a single X-close modal to CREATE and EDIT a project (name + description + a multi-select of the tenant's data-lists showing each list's sendable_count) and an Archive action; the modal uses the X-icon-top-right close (no 'İptal' text button) per the project UX rule.
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: Codex (gpt-5.5) iter0 PASS — CQ10 + CoVe Q3; SPA build (tsc+vite) clean.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The api.ts client gains typed Project types (ProjectSummary/ProjectTargetDto/ProjectDetail/CreateProjectRequest/UpdateProjectRequest matching the Shared ProjectDtos JSON contract) + methods listProjects/getProject/createProject/updateProject/archiveProject hitting /api/v1/outbound/projects*, reusing the existing listDataLists for the target multi-select; a 403 renders the calm 'hesabınızda etkin değil' state (ApiClientError status===403) and 404/409/422 surface their actionable INV-OB messages — no raw error dumps.
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: Codex (gpt-5.5) iter0 PASS — CQ1/CQ12 + CoVe Q4.

acceptance_criteria.verification_note: Codex (gpt-5.5) iter0 PASS — CQ3/CQ5/CQ8 + CoVe Q2/Q3; dual-source nav verified in both Layout.tsx + /api/v1/inma/nav; SPA tsc+vite + .NET both clean.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: The /api/v1/projects endpoints live in Outbound (S2); S4 adds Backend proxy routes /api/v1/outbound/projects/* that forward the bearer straight through, exactly like the data-lists GR4 proxy block — no Backend-side tenant/gating logic.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Established GR4 precedent (Program.cs ~3666): the Backend is a thin proxy over Outbound for tenant-scoped Outbound-plan features; Outbound owns ExtractTenant + ProjectsOptions gating. Re-implementing tenant logic at the Backend would duplicate + risk drift.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: thin pass-through proxy mirroring data-lists; the /api/v1/outbound/ prefix carries the JWT + Outbound FeatureGuard, Outbound does the tenant scoping + ProjectsOptions gate. Not a missing-auth hole.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: S4 is METADATA-ONLY: the create/edit form collects only name + description + target_list_ids. The WhatsApp template picker, instance selection, and any send action are DEFERRED to PR-4; the S3 /api/v1/settings/wa-templates endpoint is NOT consumed in S4 and no unused api.ts method is added for it.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Q interview decision. The S2 projects CRUD intentionally has no cxapi-config columns (instance_id/template_kind/wa_template_id/param_mapping are inert until PR-4), so a template selection has nowhere to persist. Shipping a picker now would be an un-saveable, misleading control. Adding an unused getWaTemplates() client method now would be dead frontend code.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: no template/send UI and no wa-templates client call in S4 — this is intentional scope, not a missing feature. The S3 endpoint exists for PR-4's picker. Keeps S4 honest + free of dead code.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: DELETE is surfaced to the operator as 'Arşivle' (Archive), not 'Sil' (hard delete); the list excludes archived projects.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: S2 DELETE is soft-delete-as-archive (bulk_send_jobs.project_id is ON DELETE RESTRICT); a project with runs can never be hard-deleted. The UI label must be honest about the semantics.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED 'Arşivle' wording + archived rows excluded from the list. Matches the S2 soft-delete-as-archive contract; not a delete bug.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: The 'Projeler' nav entry is added to BOTH Layout.tsx ALL_NAV_ITEMS AND the Backend GET /api/v1/inma/nav response (workspace section) in the same commit.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: The tenant nav has two sources (Dashboard's own Layout when standalone; the Backend /api/v1/inma/nav when embedded in the INMA Angular shell). The 2026-06-04 incident was caused by updating only one. Both must stay in sync.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED dual-source nav edit (Layout.tsx + /api/v1/inma/nav). Updating only one is the known 2026-06-04 stale-nav bug; updating both is correct, not scope creep.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: The Projeler nav item + page are always-visible (no InseFeatures flag) and rely on the in-page calm 403 state when ProjectsOptions denies (INV-OB-066), mirroring 'Veri Yönetimi'.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: ProjectsOptions is a server-side allowlist gate, not an InseFeatures flag; the sibling Veri Yönetimi has no feature flag and renders a calm 'not enabled' state on 403 (DataImportPage precedent). Consistent UX + one mental model.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED no feature-flag gate on the nav item; the 403 calm state is the gate surface, same as data-lists/DataImportPage. Not an authorization gap (Outbound enforces the gate server-side).

verification_questions.question: Are the 5 Backend project routes a thin pass-through proxy (bearer forwarded straight to Outbound /api/v1/projects* via OutboundProxy{Get,Post,Put,Delete}, no Backend-side tenant logic) so tenant scoping + ProjectsOptions gating stay solely in Outbound, and can one tenant never see/edit another tenant's project through this layer?

Is S4 genuinely metadata-only and send-path independent — the create/edit form posts only name/description/target_list_ids, no cxapi config or template is collected or sent, the S3 wa-templates endpoint is not consumed, no CxapiSend/BulkSend allowlist or the P0-3 gate is touched, and any send/dispatch UI is absent (deferred to PR-4)?

Is the routing/nav change complete and consistent — the new /projects route is registered under ProtectedRoute+Layout, AND the 'Projeler' entry is added to BOTH Layout.tsx ALL_NAV_ITEMS and the Backend /api/v1/inma/nav workspace section (the 2026-06-04 dual-source rule) — and does DELETE surface as 'Arşivle' with archived projects excluded from the list (S2 soft-delete-as-archive)?

Does the page handle every S2 response honestly — a 403 renders the calm 'hesabınızda etkin değil' state (ApiClientError status===403, not a red error), and 404 (INV-OB-068)/409 name-conflict (INV-OB-069)/422 invalid-target (INV-OB-070) surface their actionable Turkish messages — with no raw error dump and no silent failure, and does the target multi-select reuse the existing listDataLists (showing sendable_count) rather than inventing a new endpoint?

forbidden_areas: Any CxapiSend/BulkSend feature-flag or AllowedTenantIds config (P0-3 gate untouched)
The S3 /api/v1/settings/wa-templates endpoint + WapCrmTemplateClient (not consumed in S4; PR-4 wires the picker)
The Outbound projects CRUD (S2) + ProjectDtos contract (S4 only consumes them)
The bulk send engine / MessageSenderService / any dispatch path
arch/db/** (S4 is UI + proxy only; no schema change)
non_goals: WhatsApp template picker / instance selection / param mapping (PR-4)
Sending or dispatching from a project (PR-4 + gate lift)
Run history / counters UI beyond surfacing the read-only ProjectSummary counters
A getWaTemplates() api.ts method (added in PR-4 with its picker — avoids dead code now)
intentional_exclusions: No new Backend tenant/gating logic on the proxy routes — Outbound owns it (GR4 precedent)
No InseFeatures flag on the nav item — calm 403 state is the gate surface (Veri Yönetimi precedent)
No 3-step wizard — a single X-close modal suffices for metadata (Q decision)
No automated tests (project convention: tests only when requested)

try_catch_locations: ProjectsPage load/create/update/archive — try/catch around api calls: ApiClientError status===403 -> calm featureDisabled state; other statuses -> actionable message via the INV-OB code/message (errText helper), never a raw dump

Backend proxy routes — no new try/catch; OutboundClient.ProxyRequestAsync already maps transport/timeout to 502/504 (INV-BE-001/002), and Outbound returns the INV-OB coded bodies which pass through verbatim
user_facing_errors: Calm: 'Bu özellik hesabınızda henüz etkin değil.' (403 INV-OB-066)
INV-OB-068 'Proje bulunamadı.' / INV-OB-069 'Bu isimde bir proje zaten var...' / INV-OB-070 'Seçilen listelerden biri bulunamadı...' surfaced on create/edit
Generic load failure: 'Projeler yüklenemedi' with a retry affordance
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: Every api call is awaited in a try/catch; a 403 maps to the calm not-enabled panel, all other errors surface the server's INV-OB code + actionable message (no swallow, no raw JSON). The Backend proxy is a pass-through that does not mask Outbound's coded responses. No write happens client-side without a server round-trip whose outcome is shown.

aha_moments.user_pain: Operators rebuild the same audience every campaign and can't save 'who + which lists' as a reusable, named unit.
aha_moments.suggestion: A Projeler page where you create a named project once, attach saved lists, and see each list's live sendable_count + the projected audience total at a glance.
aha_moments.aha_moment: When the operator opens 'Yaz Kampanyası' and instantly sees '3 liste · 4.812 gönderilebilir' instead of re-picking lists from scratch.

aha_moments.user_pain: Prospects ask if Invekto supports repeatable, list-targeted WhatsApp campaigns (TONIVA mode4 parity) and a one-off CSV blast doesn't demo well.
aha_moments.suggestion: The Projeler page is the visible, operator-facing 'campaigns' surface — create a project, attach lists, see the audience — even before send is enabled.
aha_moments.aha_moment: When a demo creates a 'Proje' live and the prospect sees the repeatable-campaign story land before send is even on.

aha_moments.user_pain: A management UI that lets you attach the wrong/deleted list silently is a dead-send waiting to happen.
aha_moments.suggestion: The multi-select shows only the tenant's active lists (with sendable_count); a since-deleted list cleanly fails server-side with 'Seçilen listelerden biri bulunamadı' instead of saving a broken project.
aha_moments.aha_moment: When picking a stale list fails with a clear message rather than creating a project that can never run.

aha_moments.user_pain: Deleting a finished project would destroy the run history finance/support need.
aha_moments.suggestion: The destructive action is 'Arşivle' (soft-delete): the ON DELETE RESTRICT FK guarantees a project with runs can never be erased, and the name is freed for reuse.
aha_moments.aha_moment: When support archives an old project, reuses its name for a new one, and the archived original (with counters) is still there months later.

aha_moments.user_pain: Editing a project's list selection one add/remove at a time is tedious and error-prone.
aha_moments.suggestion: The edit modal replaces the whole target set in one save (the PUT sends the final id list, atomic set-replace server-side).
aha_moments.aha_moment: When swapping the lists on a project saves in one click with no partial state.

aha_moments.user_pain: A tenant nav that's edited in only one place goes stale in the other shell (the 2026-06-04 INMA stale-nav incident).
aha_moments.suggestion: Add 'Projeler' to BOTH Layout.tsx and the Backend /api/v1/inma/nav in the same commit so the standalone Dashboard and the embedded INMA shell agree.
aha_moments.aha_moment: When the Projeler item appears identically whether the tenant opens Invekto standalone or inside the INMA Angular shell.

verdict.raw_text: Codex (mcp__codex-review__codex_review, model gpt-5.5-2026-04-23) iteration 0: OVERALL PASS. Code Quality Gate 12/12 PASS (CQ1-CQ12), CoVe 4/4 PASS (Q1-Q4), 0 blocking. Clean iter0. Findings: thin pass-through proxy (no Backend tenant logic, isolation preserved — cxapi/Outbound boundary respected); metadata-only (only name/description/target_list_ids posted; no getWaTemplates / template picker / send UI); dual-source nav verified (Layout.tsx + /api/v1/inma/nav); DELETE surfaced as Arşivle (soft-delete-as-archive); 403 calm state + errText INV-OB surfacing, only the data-lists-load fallback is a deliberate silent-to-empty; no schema/breaking-contract change. The committed wwwroot/app bundle is generated output (not in the reviewed source diff).

CQ1.evidence: errText() preserves ApiClientError code/message; load/create/update/get/archive surface errors; 403 -> calm feature-disabled state.

CQ2.evidence: Only silent catch is the intentional listDataLists fallback-to-empty (must not block the projects view); project-level ops all surface errors.

CQ3.evidence: Diff limited to the 5 declared source files; changes match plan scope (5 proxy routes + nav + route + client/types + page).

CQ4.evidence: Proxy routes intentionally mirror the data-lists pass-through; page uses shared Button/Input; no harmful duplication.

CQ5.evidence: Backend uses existing OutboundProxy* helpers; route lazy under ProtectedRoute/Layout; nav updated in both sources (dual-source convention).

CQ6.evidence: One projects load + one data-lists load on mount; reload after mutations; in-memory id filtering; no N+1/polling/unclosed resource.

CQ8.evidence: Additive only: new Project types/methods, new /projects route, new proxy routes; nothing removed/renamed.

CQ9.evidence: Thin proxies to Outbound /api/v1/projects* (no direct DB access); tenant scoping + ProjectsOptions gate stay in Outbound; UI sends only metadata.

CQ10.evidence: navy/brand Tailwind + shared Button/Input; 403 calm message (not red); Archive label + confirm = soft-delete-as-archive semantics.

CQ11.evidence: No new DB query/table/migration/column; Backend only proxies; frontend DTOs snake_case match the API contract.

CQ12.evidence: Server INV-OB code+message preserved via errText; 403 specifically handled; actionable Turkish messages; no new bare catch.

Q1.reasoning: Exactly 5 routes delegating to OutboundProxy{Get,Post,Put,Delete} with /api/v1/projects paths; no Backend DB/tenant/authz logic — proxy boundary preserved.

Q2.reasoning: Create/update post only name/description/target_list_ids; no getWaTemplates, template picker, cxapi field, or send/dispatch UI added.

Q3.reasoning: /projects lazy route under ProtectedRoute+Layout; nav in BOTH Layout.tsx + /api/v1/inma/nav; DELETE exposed as Arşivle (soft-delete-as-archive) + reload.

Q4.reasoning: 403 -> calm 'etkin değil'; other errors via errText (INV-OB surfaced); only listDataLists fallback swallowed; target multi-select reuses listDataLists + sendable_count.
